name: OnlyFlix Local
description: OnlyFlix local build. NontonGo 0.10.4 restores a single provider and returns all Soap2Cloud qualities sequentially using compact non-base64 in-memory HLS playlists.

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · CDNM
scrapers.description: Pure local CDNM with device-side TMDB→IMDb lookup, PlayerJS #2 decoding and explicit 1080p/720p/480p/360p/240p variants when available.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · VidAPI
scrapers.description: Pure local VidAPI/VAPlayer. Master HLS playlists are expanded into explicit resolution streams with actual pixel dimensions.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · NontonGo
scrapers.description: Single-provider local NontonGo. Soap2Cloud qualities are processed sequentially; malformed EXT-X-MAP is repaired and playlists use compact non-base64 data URIs.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · VidFast
scrapers.description: Pure local VidFast using the direct VA upstream source=vidfast path. Master HLS playlists are expanded into explicit resolution streams. No helper resolver.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local
